why: Company release dated 2026-08-19 confirms Q2 fiscal 2026 results after market close on 2026-09-02 with a 16:30 ET call; calendar amc is right.
where_to_look: New-store productivity, not comps, is where the model breaks: the release gives store count and new-store openings, and the ratio of new-store sales to mature-store sales is computable from the 10-Q and is the number that broke the stock in June 2026 (-13.8%)

Tariff pass-through: Five Below's assortment is heavily China-sourced at fixed price points, so the gross-margin line is a direct tariff read. Compare with Dollar Tree's and Ollie's most recent margin commentary
Shrink: the company has disclosed shrink improvement as a margin driver. The shrink accrual is in the 10-Q and is the least-forecastable line
Management is presenting at Barclays (2026-09-09) and Goldman (2026-09-15) right after the print, which constrains how much they will hold back on the call
6 estimates and reasonable coverage - moderate room. The 7.6% event-implied move sits against a 5.6% historical median
